using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Net;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Session;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Session;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Session
{
    public class SessionManager : ISessionManager
    {
        private readonly ILogger<SessionManager> _logger;
        private readonly List<SessionInfo> _sessions = new();
        private readonly ReaderWriterLockSlim _sessionsLock = new();

        public SessionManager(ILogger<SessionManager> logger)
        {
            _logger = logger;
        }

        public Task<SessionInfo> GetSessionAsync(string id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            _sessionsLock.EnterReadLock();
            try
            {
                return Task.FromResult(_sessions.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Id == id));
            }
            finally
            {
                _sessionsLock.ExitReadLock();
            }
        }

        public Task AddSessionAsync(SessionInfo session, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            _sessionsLock.EnterWriteLock();
            try
            {
                _sessions.Add(session);
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }
            finally
            {
                _sessionsLock.ExitWriteLock();
            }
        }

        public Task RemoveSessionAsync(string id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            _sessionsLock.EnterWriteLock();
            try
            {
                var session = _sessions.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Id == id);
                if (session != null)
                {
                    _sessions.Remove(session);
                }
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }
            finally
            {
                _sessionsLock.ExitWriteLock();
            }
        }

        public Task CloseIfNeededAsync(SessionInfo session, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (session.IsEmpty)
            {
                return RemoveSessionAsync(session.Id, cancellationToken);
            }
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        public void OnSessionControllerConnected(SessionInfo session)
        {
            _logger.LogDebug("Session {Session} connected.", session.Id);
        }
    }
}
